scope: CEL context construction, built-in function registration, and destruction only; excludes bindings, expression compilation/execution, source loading, authorization, queries, and serialization

build.patch: Shared index capture and benchmark committed with this artifact
build.profile: Cargo release defaults; no profile overrides or RUSTFLAGS

method.fixture: 10000 deterministic in-memory file targets, tasks/00000.md through tasks/09999.md, using the CEL unit record metadata; zero links per record
method.cache_state: one prebuilt immutable index; no disk cache or result memoization
method.deep_copy: Clone the entire index before registration to reproduce the previous function-registration path
method.shared_arc: Capture the caller's original Arc without copying targets

limitations: Component fixture is not the public 10K/100K Markdown acceptance corpus
No end-to-end latency, write durability, concurrent reader/writer, memory, or scaling gate evaluated
CPU frequency, power state, and unrelated host activity uncontrolled; one sequential development-machine run
Registration measurements do not execute CEL; separate semantic and ownership tests verify link resolution, traversal-budget reset, and release of captured references
